title: Class 7 object hovers overhead before the helicopter arrives and is seen as chrome with the naked eye

tellings.quote: We had a class 7 NAYA. We decided to raise the air helicopter, to pursue its. Even before the helicopter arrived, he flew up and hovered right above us.
On the fourth Jellyfish Day on the 7th class arrived and hovered over us for about 5 minutes.
tellings.difference: Places it on day four at 800 m for about five minutes with sensors knocked out, without the helicopter-arrival framing.
tellings.link_reason: Day-four class 7 jellyfish hovering over the hill for 5 minutes and knocking out sensors matches the class 7 object hovering overhead story.

as_told.title: On day four a 'jellyfish' hovers over the hill at 800 m and knocks out the sensors

plain: During a 2025 field operation by Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, the team says an object of the highest kind on their own scale, which they call class 7, came and hung right above them, and looked like chrome to the naked eye. James Valor, who was there, tells Michels that the team decided to send up a helicopter to chase it, but "even before the helicopter arrived, he flew up and hovered right above us." The Skywatcher team also tells it on the same episode, crediting a member named Rory. In their version it happened on the fourth day of what they call Jellyfish Day, the object "arrived and hovered over us for about 5 minutes" at around 800 metres, and it knocked out their sensors. Their version leaves out the helicopter. Both tellers are people who say they saw it themselves, from the same company. If true, it would suggest the object knew it was being chased and came toward the team rather than away.
